choices.text: The operator's notes are entirely redundant — all 40 notes state the same thing: the scheduler admits a request only when its KV booking fits the device budget; a parked session keeps its prefix entry, and a later turn that extends the same prompt restores that entry and primes only the new suffix. Each note then asks the same question (items 1–40 of a checklist): whether the restored state is byte-identical to a cold prime of the whole prompt
